claims.text: Common initial regimens for most ART-naive adults are INSTI-based (eg, bictegravir/TAF/emtricitabine; dolutegravir + TAF or TDF + emtricitabine or lamivudine; dolutegravir/lamivudine).
claims.quote: Common options for most adults who have not received ART before include INSTI-based combinations such as bictegravir/tenofovir alafenamide/emtricitabine; dolutegravir plus either tenofovir alafenamide or tenofovir disoproxil fumarate plus emtricitabine or lamivudine; and dolutegravir/lamivudine in appropriate patients.

claims.text: Not dolutegravir/lamivudine if HIV RNA >500,000 copies/mL, HBV coinfection, or before genotype and HBV results are back.
claims.quote: Dolutegravir/lamivudine should not be used in patients with HIV RNA > 500,000 copies/mL or hepatitis B virus coinfection, or when ART is initiated before results of HIV genotypic resistance testing or hepatitis B testing are available.

claims.text: Dolutegravir: 50 mg PO once daily (ART-naive or INSTI-naive adults).
claims.locator: 2.2 Recommended Dosage in Adults › Treatment-naïve or treatment-experienced INSTI-naïve adults

claims.text: Take dolutegravir 2 h before or 6 h after cation antacids/laxatives, sucralfate, iron or calcium supplements, buffered meds (with food, calcium or iron can be taken together).
claims.quote: TIVICAY or TIVICAY PD should be taken 2 hours before or 6 hours after taking cation-containing antacids or laxatives, sucralfate, oral supplements containing iron or calcium, or buffered medications. When taken with food, TIVICAY and supplements containing calcium or iron can be taken at the same time.

claims.text: Bictegravir is CI with rifampin or rifabutin (↓ levels, ART failure).
claims.quote: coformulated bictegravir is contraindicated when co-administered with a tuberculosis treatment containing rifampin or rifabutin. Rifampin and rifabutin strongly induce the metabolism of bictegravir, reducing its levels and predisposing the patient to ART failure.

claims.text: Hypersensitivity (rash, constitutional sx, sometimes organ dysfunction incl. liver injury; <1%): stop at once.
claims.quote: Hypersensitivity reactions have been reported and were characterized by rash, constitutional findings, and sometimes organ dysfunction, including liver injury. The events were reported in less than 1% of participants receiving TIVICAY in Phase III clinical trials. Discontinue TIVICAY or TIVICAY PD and other suspect agents immediately if signs or symptoms of hypersensitivity reactions develop

claims.text: Hepatotoxicity, higher risk with HBV or HCV; monitor.
claims.quote: Hepatotoxicity has been reported in patients receiving dolutegravir-containing regimens. Patients with underlying hepatitis B or C may be at increased risk for worsening or development of transaminase elevations. Monitoring for hepatotoxicity is recommended.

claims.text: INSTIs are the class most linked to weight gain.
claims.quote: Integrase inhibitors are most commonly implicated in causing weight gain
